text: I was hurt in a car accident in Canberra. Which compensation lawyers should I contact?

result.keyword: I was hurt in a car accident in Canberra. Which compensation lawyers should I contact?
result.markdown:
[Turner Freeman Lawyers](https://maps.google.com/?cid=3533568153289982770&g_mp=Cidnb29nbGUubWFwcy5wbGFjZXMudjEuUGxhY2VzLlNlYXJjaFRleHQ) is an established firm specializing in motor vehicle accidents and Compulsory Third Party (CTP) insurance claims under ACT law. Reviewers and clients frequently highlight their structured, supportive guidance through complex personal injury procedures.

* Operates on a **No Win, No Fee** basis for motor vehicle accident claims.
* Offers free initial case assessments.
* Located centrally in Canberra on Ainslie Place.

[Shine Lawyers](https://maps.google.com/?cid=16551176721109406753&g_mp=Cidnb29nbGUubWFwcy5wbGFjZXMudjEuUGxhY2VzLlNlYXJjaFRleHQ) is a nationally recognized personal injury firm with a dedicated local presence in Canberra. They handle a wide spectrum of road trauma claims, helping clients navigate compensation for medical expenses and lost wages.

* Provides **No Win, No Fee** structures for eligible compensation claims.
* Offers flexible appointment arrangements, including virtual consultations or home visits if travel is difficult.
* Situated on Petrie Plaza in the heart of the city.

[Stacks Goudkamp](https://maps.google.com/?cid=6537169756560219710&g_mp=Cidnb29nbGUubWFwcy5wbGFjZXMudjEuUGxhY2VzLlNlYXJjaFRleHQ) brings decades of personal injury expertise to the ACT, assisting individuals injured in motor vehicle incidents. Clients note their thorough approach to maximizing compensation outcomes.

* Operates on a **No Win, No Fee** policy.
* Offers a free initial consultation to evaluate your eligibility.
* Located on Northbourne Avenue.
